pos.personaBrief: Pedro Emanuel prepared 'para ter a bola e não permitir contra-ataques' (Santos) and wants possession 'mais objetiva', with offensive transition part of the game; the Fluminense win also used a counter. Ball-leaning, but not sterile possession.

pro.personaBrief: He asks for more objectivity when reaching 'entrelinhas' and says offensive transition is part of the game; the 2-0 vs Fluminense came from a fast counter. Build-up under pressure is a verified gap, so pro_02 leans on general knowledge.

est.personaBrief: VAVEL describes a 'rigoroso' 4-2-3-1 / 4-1-4-1 with defined roles (Gómez left, Paulo Henrique overlapping right) and he talks of rigour and a shared 'processo de jogo'; players float between the lines, so wingers can come inside.

lar.personaBrief: Against Fluminense the attack ran through Andrés Gómez on the left and constant overlaps of Paulo Henrique on the right, with a low cross for Brenner's goal: the flanks are a main route.

blo.personaBrief: Mid/high 4-1-4-1 block with individual marking that 'asfixiaram a saída de bola' of Fluminense, and 23 recoveries in the offensive half vs Santos with coordinated pressure: a pressing team.

mar.personaBrief: The only analysis shows 'marcações individuais' encaixed on Fluminense's build-up, possibly a match plan; set-piece marking is a gap, so corners lean on general Portuguese-coach knowledge (zonal/mixed).

pla.personaBrief: He 'zerou tudo' and installed his plan, but the Fluminense win was a tailored organization 'que neutralizou o sistema de Zubeldía', and he switches 'modo campeonato' to 'modo copas': identity with strong opponent-specific adaptation.

res.personaBrief: Result-driven: 'cirúrgico' changes and a late back five to 'fechar a casa' vs Fluminense, an unbeaten cup run with few goals conceded, and a relegation fight in the league.

sis.personaBrief: 'Todos intervêm, todos fazem parte do nosso processo de jogo' and 'para se entrar na equipe, tem que ser melhor': the collective plan and pressing duties come before individual licence.

jog.personaBrief: No verified evidence on player type (gap); from general knowledge and consistent with the verified intensity (pressing, 'colocar o mais fresco para correr', midfield trio that 'esmagou' Fluminense) he values intensity but also passing quality in midfield.

bas.personaBrief: He praises academy player Ramon Rique and wants more like him, but 'não quero queimar etapas' and won't drop performing players for a new one: youth is developed gradually while experience carries the team.

lid.personaBrief: Demanding meritocracy ('quem tiver a oportunidade terá que mostrar serviço, senão outro entra') with emphasis on mental freshness and a united group; authority with care for the group.
